run_visEFT_singleSubject: run the script to visualize single person SMPL mesh fits from EFT pickle files
run_visEFT_multiSubjects: run the script to visualize multi-person SMPL mesh fits overlaid on the same image
run_getRenderer: run the script with a geo, normal, or densepose render mode for 3D mesh visualization
run_visEFT_onbbox: run the script with --onbbox to render 3D pose on cropped bounding box space
run_visEFT_save_rendered: run the script to render and save SMPL mesh overlays as JPEG images to a directory
